suggestions.title: Defer Non-Critical JS Files
suggestions.description: Many non-critical JS files (e.g., `auth0-spa-js.production.js`, `video.js`) have a significant unused portion pre-LCP.
suggestions.implementation: Code splitting can ensure that only essential parts load initially. Deter loading of non-essential scripts until after the principal content has appeared.
suggestions.codeExample: Use dynamic imports or conditional loading patterns.

suggestions.title: Optimize Critical Path Rendering
suggestions.description: Large image is causing delayed LCP.
suggestions.implementation: Eager-load critical images. Utilize `fetchpriority` high in JavaScript to prioritize downloading crucial images.

suggestions.title: Remove Long Task from `scripts.js`
suggestions.implementation: Break down long tasks using `requestIdleCallback` or similar to help yield control of the main thread.

suggestions.title: Self-Host Third-Party Resources
suggestions.description: External resources causing delays due to separate domain loading.
suggestions.implementation: Consider self-hosting scripts like those from the Auth0 domain.
